vulnerability.name: USN-8200-1
vulnerability.description: Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems:   - ARM64 architecture;   - Cryptographic API;   - GPU drivers;   - I2C subsystem;   - Network traffic control; (CVE-2022-49046, CVE-2024-46816, CVE-2025-37849, CVE-2026-23060, CVE-2026-23074)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in the Linux kernel.
